lines.en: 'The play may begin at any moment,' I said.
'It may have begun already,' Susan answered.
lines.zh: “也许已经开演了呢，”苏珊回答说。

lines.en: I hurried to the ticket office. 'May I have two tickets please?
lines.zh: 我匆匆赶到售票处，问：“我可以买两张票吗？

lines.en: 'I'm sorry, we've sold out,' the girl said.
Susan exclaimed Just then, a man hurried to the ticket office.

lines.en: I went back to the ticket office at once.
'Could I have those two tickets please?
'Certainly,' the girl said, 'but they're for next Wednesday's performance.

lines.zh: “当然可以，不过这两张票是下星期三的，您是否还要呢？

lines.en: 'I might as well have them,' I said sadly
lines.zh: ”“我还是买下的好，”我垂头丧气地说。
